title: Will "Housewife" rank No. 1–2 on Billboard Hot 100? Rank 1 to 2
rules: If "Housewife" by Tate McRae ranks between No. 1 and No. 2, inclusive on the Billboard Hot 100 for the chart dated Oct 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Billboard. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

blind.reasoning: Housewife is Tate McRae's new solo single, out Oct. 15, 2026, so its first full tracking week feeds the Oct. 31 chart. Her solo singles have peaked at No. 3 at best, and her only No. 1 was a duet with Morgan Wallen. Taking the top two would mean a career-best solo debut against unknown competition, so YES is unlikely but possible.
blind.falsifier: Very strong first-week streams for Housewife (for example, a big US Spotify debut near the top with sustained daily volume) during a week with no blockbuster album or chart-topper, leading to a No. 1 or No. 2 Hot 100 debut.

final.reasoning: The 40% price likely reflects first-week streaming data I couldn't access, so I raised my estimate from 6% to 20%. A top-two solo debut would still beat McRae's best solo peak of No. 3 against unknown competition, so I lean NO.
